editorial: Prepare to question every familiar face in your house. You will find yourself trapped in a claustrophobic nightmare where the boundaries between maternal love and parasitic hunger blur into one. Rob Savage delivers a masterclass in uncanny valley horror, using a hauntingly mirrored performance to trigger your deepest instincts of dread. If you crave psychological torture that lingers long after the credits roll, this is your next obsession.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of high-concept psychological horror and domestic thrillers.
